setup.notice: Runs the unmodified Claude Code CLI with your own Anthropic account and requires Node.js 22 or later. Not made or endorsed by Anthropic. The token or key you save here is stored in Devin, so new sessions can use it without signing in.
steps: Using a Claude subscription (Pro, Max, Ultra, Team or Enterprise): on any computer with Node.js and a browser, run `npx -y @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.315 setup-token`.
Approve access in the browser, then copy the token printed in your terminal. It is shown only once and lasts one year.
Paste it into CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN below and save. When it expires, repeat these steps.
Using an API key instead: leave the token empty and paste a key from platform.claude.com into ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. If you save both, the subscription token is used.
To have Claude Code preinstalled instead of fetched with npx on first use, add `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code` to the environment's blueprint.
